metadata.name: [REP+] reHUD [Forked]
metadata.description:
Fork of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1906405707]reHUD[/url] by wofsauge updated to Repentance+. Obviously use only one of two.
Adds a more customizable smaller version of the "Extra HUD", which displays the gametime and a list of collected items on the screen.
[h1]What this fork changes[/h1] - [b]Runs on Repentance+[/b]. The original targets Afterbirth+. - [b]Settings through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3844329336]Yet Another Mod Config Menu[/url][/b] ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3701683951]Mod Config Menu Impure[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2681875787]Mod Config Menu Pure[/url] work too; enable only one), saved in reHUD's own save. - [b]Follows the HUD Offset option.[/b] - [b]Shows as many items as fit on screen[/b], newest first, grouped by floor. - [b]Repentance floor names, in every game language[/b]: Russian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese floor names no longer show up blank. - [b]New filters[/b]: active items, and temporary items (Lemegeton wisps, Zodiac, 3 Dollar Bill), which are marked with a small clock. - [b]One icon per copy[/b]: an item held twice (picked up twice, owned plus a character's innate copy like Cain's Lucky Foot, owned plus a Lemegeton wisp) shows twice. Each wisp, Zodiac or 3 Dollar Bill copy gets its own clock; when a copy goes, the oldest icon of that kind leaves. - [b]Timer[/b] shows hundredths of a second. - [b]Co-op and Jacob and Esau[/b]: lists every character's items, grouped by player within each floor and each marked with a character number when there is more than one (Esau, Strawman's Keeper, the Esau summoned by Soul of Jacob and Esau while he stays, each Tainted Lazarus form and each Esau Jr. form get their own). A dead player's items stay listed; items of players who leave stay hidden unless [b]Show items of players who left[/b] is on. When Clicker turns Jacob and Esau into one character, Esau's items move to it and keep their floors (his temporary items go); Clicker into Jacob and Esau gives the new Esau his share, floors kept. - [b]Characters survive swaps[/b]: Tainted Lazarus's Flip (Birthright too), Esau Jr., Clicker and Exit and Continue keep each character's items under its own character number. A swapped-out form stays listed until it comes back, and a character Esau Jr. put away stays listed until the run ends (the game keeps it that long). When Clicker or a character change merges Tainted Lazarus's two forms, their items move to the merged character, as in the game. Limit: Esau Jr. can make characters reHUD cannot tell apart after Exit and Continue. The one you were playing when you exited keeps its number, but two others like that can swap character numbers once they play again, and their items then show under the current floor. After a Continue with two Esau Jr. copies in use, a character brought back by someone other than the one it last swapped places with gets a new character number, and its old one stays listed.
[h1]Features of original[/h1] - [b]Display your last collected items on the screen[/b]. over 100 of them instead of the last 10 in the normal game. - [b]Customize the display[/b]: Position (Right, Bottom), Amount of Coloumns, Size, Transparency,.. - [b]Display a more accurate ingame Timer![/b] Precise up to milliseconds ;) - [b]Filter your items[/b]. Display Passives or only Familiars. - [b]Sort your items[/b]. Order them by the floor they are collected on.
[h1]Support[/h1] Bugs, questions, ideas: [url=https://discord.gg/5KvKaUpsvR]Discord[/url]
[h1]Special Thanks[/h1] to wofsauge for the original reHUD! to Piber for the Mod config menu! to Skojanza for helping bugfix the original mod to _Kilburn for the screen-size helper in the original mod
